limitations: Transparent or background-colored text without a detectable filled bubble can be missed
Announcements with the same filled-bubble geometry can remain
Three-second-or-longer sampling can miss transient comments and increases latency
ReplayKit screen capture overhead remains; real device load and GRAVITY responsiveness after this revision are untested
Speech queue remains bounded at 60 entries / 90 seconds / 2000 characters each
All themes, keyboard variants, devices and future OS versions are untested

comparison.user_observation: User confirmed v0.7 speech works, but scope is too broad and GRAVITY is too slow to operate
comparison.preserved_audio_route: Same playback + mixWithOthers session and main-queue AVSpeechSynthesizer; startup speech retained
comparison.changed: 192px filled-surface selection without avatar/name gates; OCR only union of surfaces; no-surface OCR skip; bubble-only fingerprint; lower OCR pixel budget; economy sampling; optimized Debug build
comparison.default_frame_processor: lightweight=true for live broadcast and photo diagnostics
comparison.reference_paths: 37 strict + 21 v0.7 broad native checks retained; 19 new balanced checks
failed_regressions_fixed: No filled surface still read text
Economy budget did not throttle scans

benchmark.scope: Same generated 750x1334 three-message room, five uncached samples after warmup, both optimized, same CI host; NOT real iPhone/GRAVITY performance
